title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 have a vulnerability where a remote authenticated attacker can bypass security restrictions due to the absence of the X-Content-Type-Options header, which allows MIME type sniffing. This vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.4. No patch or remediation information is provided.
